level.tutorial.name: The Training Yard
level.tutorial.intro.1: Welcome, recruit. Here you learn everything you need before going down into the crypts.
level.tutorial.outro.1: You are ready: the crypts await. May the Dawn guide you!

sign.tutorial.s_yard: Room goal: defeat every enemy, then reach the exit on the right.
sign.tutorial.s_workshop: Lever: opens the portcullis. Plate A + plate B: open the door. An ally must hold plate B.
sign.tutorial.s_vault: Push the block onto the pedestal. Take the blue key, then open the blue door.
sign.tutorial.s_dark: Dark room: your torch burns down. Refill it at a lit brazier, then light the other one.
sign.tutorial.s_seal: An ally must hold the circle for 4 seconds. The 4 personal objectives open the exit.
